## Summary

Describe the change, target host/surface, and scope.

## Validation

- [ ] `python tools/validate.py`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Setup and rollback documented; existing instructions preserved
- [ ] Host tests recorded, or explicitly marked unrun
- [ ] Catalog/version/changelog updated where applicable
- [ ] No secrets or private data; attribution preserved

## Limitations

List unrun checks, host assumptions, and remaining risks.
